verdict.rationale: Claude's Cowork feature documents a built-in browser (opens sites, clicks, types, fills forms) and computer-use mode where Claude 'navigates to your screen directly—clicking, typing, and opening apps just like you would,' directly matching the story of operating applications to complete work, backed by agentic multi-step task execution and scheduling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of computer-use reliability across diverse apps and more detail on limitations/error handling.
